source_sampling.scope: Candidate-interval samples, not verified exact editing boundaries; source clothing material/production methods remain observational or inferred.

distribution: Original video, extracted source frames, user comparison sheet and generated test pixels remain local-only. Artifact locators are diagnostic labels, not repository image links. Text-only specs and original prompt hashes are distributed and reproducible.
test_method: Four text-only original characters with different roles/wardrobe decisions; two image-referenced tests for a changed occasion and a dialogue close-up. No raw film/benchmark images sent in these generation tests.

independent_review.scope: Actual viewing of six native film examples, user quality comparison and all six returned images. No mandatory visual rework found; garment fiber/read and sheer coverage differences retained below.

cases.visual_review: No-ornament apricot cotton-linen, cream facing and moss skirt have distinct weave, thickness, seams, ties and working cuffs. Warm practical character intent reads through dressing and action.
cases.limitations: No specific fiber blend or stitch count can be verified visually.

cases.visual_review: Pale gray broad-panel low-contrast woven geometry follows torso and waist; matte ivory sleeve and pale celadon edging are distinct. Refinement does not depend on gold trim.
cases.limitations: Exact weave manufacture is not proven; folio is held rather than fully tucked under the arm.

cases.visual_review: Vermilion body and sleeve field pattern, teal facings, ivory interior, dimensional bronze closures and supported waist/sleeve assembly are readable. The full-build sociable patron differs materially and structurally from the other roles.
cases.limitations: Motif scale is approximate and some interior cloth is more patterned than originally described.

cases.visual_review: Coral structured core, orchid translucent layer with overlap density, selective raised stitches and small silver fastenings are visible. Fine material and construction support a poised social presence.
cases.limitations: Sheer layer covers a wider area than the specified sleeve/side zones; no exact tailoring or fiber claim.

cases.scenario: same person different occasion and single visible garment
cases.visual_review: Same healer identity remains recognizable in an unornamented single-layer-looking blue council robe; near cloth grain, fold and edge thickness remain readable. Outfit/occasion varies without changing temperament.
cases.limitations: The cloth reads more like fine-grained handwoven cloth than specifically fine wool crepe; hidden garment layers cannot be certified from a still.

cases.scenario: tested rich costume retained in dialogue close-up
cases.visual_review: The same patron and broad-field red motifs, teal/ivory layers and bronze closures remain legible in a new dialogue composition and lighting. Clothing survives story framing and depth of field.
cases.limitations: Exact motif placement is not pixel-locked; this is one reference-assisted still, not temporal continuity proof.

generation_attempts_note: Two initial text-only requests produced no returned output during a prolonged wait; their orchestrator wait was terminated with provider outcome unknown. One bounded retry of each returned the adopted images. An initial scene-reference call rejected relative paths before an image result; normal reference_delivery preflight resolved absolute paths for the successful calls. Unreturned/rejected attempts are not visual evidence.
limits: No causal A/B baseline or general model-quality improvement claim.
No user acceptance, exact fiber/cut reconstruction, video or deterministic continuity claim.
The user comparison sheet guides quality only; it is not treated as source-film wardrobe fact.
